description: This file contains benchmark tests for ASCII string functions, including performance comparisons of various ASCII character checks and string case conversion functions, using the Google Benchmark library.

methods.name: MakeShuffledBytes
methods.description: Creates a shuffled array of all 256 byte values for benchmarking.

methods.name: AsciiBenchmark
methods.description: Runs ASCII character function benchmarks over a shuffled byte array.

methods.name: BM_Ascii
methods.description: Template function to benchmark a given ASCII function.

methods.name: BM_StrToLower
methods.description: Benchmark for converting a string to lowercase using absl::AsciiStrToLower.

methods.name: BM_StrToUpper
methods.description: Benchmark for converting a string to uppercase using absl::AsciiStrToUpper.
